text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of undergraduate school5.Two recommendation lettersFrom professor,associate professor or equivalents.6.CV( in Chinese or English)7.Study PlanIncluding study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
